x-openregister._seedDataNote: Seed objects MOVED to lib/Settings/profiles/*.json (OpenSpec change seed-profiles). A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

DecisionTemplate.title: DecisionTemplate
DecisionTemplate.description: Unified template for what governs a decision: route stages (state machine), voting rule, quorum policy, urgency policy, decision content (proposedText/regulationSource), and an ordered checklist of required/optional check items. Selected by decisionType (optional; absent = generic default for the context, mirroring GovernanceBody.processTemplate's existing default-template semantics) crossed with context. Supersedes ProcessTemplate (route/voting/quorum/urgency), VveDecisionTemplate, and ModelreglementPreset (decision content + modelreglement category majorities, now folded in as this template's own defaults): see openspec/changes/unified-decision-templates/design.md. Schema-declaration only: no consumer (ProcessTemplateService, DecisionTransitionGuard, the admin Vue surface) reads this schema yet; that is unified-decision-templates-consumer-rewrite.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional description of when this template applies.

decisionType.title: Decision type
decisionType.description: Optional narrowing to one of Decision.decisionType's values. Absent means this template is the generic default for its context (mirrors GovernanceBody.processTemplate's existing default-template role; see GovernanceBody.additionalTemplates[] for the specialised-per-type resolution this anticipates). No enum: the vocabulary is configuration, held by the decidiq decision_types app setting and enforced by DecisionTypeRegistry (decision-types-as-configuration).

context.title: Context
context.description: Governance context this template is intended for (maps to the guard fallback domain when unset). Same enum as GovernanceBody.domain and the legacy ProcessTemplate.context.

templateCategory.title: Template category
templateCategory.description: Optional free-vocabulary narrowing field for templates that need a finer classification than decisionType alone (e.g. the VvE ALV categories: discharge, annual-accounts, reserve-fund-contribution, mjop-adoption, authorisation-above-threshold, amendment-internal-regulations, other). Selection-scoped only: does not grow Decision.decisionType's vocabulary (design.md Decision 2).

builtIn.title: Built-in
builtIn.description: Read-only built-in template shipped with the app. Edit/delete are refused; duplicate is allowed (clears this flag).

initialState.title: Initial state
initialState.description: The state a decision enters this template at. Absent for content-only templates that carry no stateMachine (e.g. the ported VvE ALV templates).

stateMachine.title: State machine
stateMachine.description: Structured state machine (1:1 convertible to Symfony Workflow YAML). states[] declares the lifecycle states; transitions[] declares the edges. This is the per-decision lifecycle graph DecisionTransitionGuard walks for a decision's own status field: a distinct concept from decision-route's DecisionStage route objects (design.md Decision 3). Absent for content-only templates.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional description of the lifecycle state.

chairOnly.title: Chair only
chairOnly.description: Whether only the chair may trigger this transition.

guards.title: Guards
guards.description: Guard tokens enforced before this transition (quorum_met, chair_only, all_amendments_resolved, legal_review_complete).

votingRule.title: Voting rule
votingRule.description: Default voting rule applied to rounds opened under a body/decision assigned this template.

voteThreshold.title: Vote threshold
voteThreshold.description: Majority rule applied when tallying a round under this template.

abstentionHandling.title: Abstention handling
abstentionHandling.description: Whether abstentions are excluded from or counted in the calculation base.

tieBreakRule.title: Tie-break rule
tieBreakRule.description: How a tied round is resolved under this template.

quorumRequired.title: Quorum required
quorumRequired.description: Whether quorum must be met before a decision may enter the voting state under this template. Absent for content-only templates (no state machine to gate).

quorumRule.title: Quorum rule
quorumRule.description: Free-text human description of the quorum requirement (e.g. '50%+1 of members present or represented', or a folded modelreglement quorum fraction plus article reference for VvE-derived templates).

allowDecideWithoutVote.title: Allow decide without vote
allowDecideWithoutVote.description: Permits the deliberating -> decided edge (operational domains where a formal voting round is optional).

urgencyPolicy.title: Urgency policy
urgencyPolicy.description: Per-template urgent-decision-procedure policy (folded in natively from the legacy urgencyPolicy delta, no longer a bolt-on). Absent = the urgent procedure is unavailable for bodies/decisions assigned this template (fail closed).

allowedTriggerRoles.title: Allowed trigger roles
allowedTriggerRoles.description: Role tokens permitted to declare a decision urgent (e.g. chair, secretary, board-member). Must be non-empty and contain only recognised tokens (validated save-time by the consumer once rewired).

minimumNoticeFloorHours.title: Minimum notice floor (hours)
minimumNoticeFloorHours.description: The shortest convocation notice, in hours, an emergency (extraordinary) meeting under this template may use.

responseDeadlineHours.title: Response deadline bounds (hours)
responseDeadlineHours.description: Inclusive bounds, in hours, on the expedited written-round response deadline.

min.title: Minimum hours
min.description: Shortest permitted expedited-round response deadline, in hours.

max.title: Maximum hours
max.description: Longest permitted expedited-round response deadline, in hours.

ratificationRequired.title: Ratification required
ratificationRequired.description: Whether an urgent decision under this template must be routed to a mandatory ratifying stage.

ratifyingBody.title: Ratifying body
ratifyingBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody that ratifies an urgent decision (overridable at trigger time). Seed refs are stored by slug and mapped to UUID at import.

proposedText.title: Proposed text
proposedText.description: The standard besluittekst pre-filled into the Decision when instantiated from this template (from VveDecisionTemplate; may carry placeholders like {boekjaar}).
proposedText.example: De vergadering verleent het bestuur decharge over het boekjaar {boekjaar}.

regulationSource.title: Regulation source
regulationSource.description: Free text naming the modelreglement article (or BW/Woningwet/Gemeentewet source) this template's route/majority derives from. Flagged for juridical review before release, same posture as VveDecisionTemplate/ModelreglementPreset carried.

checklist.title: Checklist
checklist.description: Ordered required/optional check items a decision under this template is expected to satisfy. NEW in this schema: no legacy template family had a checklist. Declares the checklist definition only; instantiating a per-decision checklist-progress object is consumer-rewrite/decision-instance work, out of scope here.

sequence.title: Sequence
sequence.description: Ordering position of this check item within the checklist.

label.title: Label
label.description: Human-readable name of the check item.

required.title: Required
required.description: Whether this check item must be completed before the decision may advance.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional detail/instructions for this check item.

migratedFrom.title: Migrated from
migratedFrom.description: Provenance marker set only on objects created by the repair migration (MigrateLegacyTemplatesToDecisionTemplate) from a legacy process-template/vve-decision-template object. Absent on built-in seeds and on admin-created templates.

sourceSchema.title: Source schema
sourceSchema.description: The legacy schema slug the source object was read from.

sourceUuid.title: Source identifier
sourceUuid.description: Provenance marker: the identifier the migrated object carried in its superseded schema (see sourceSchema). Deliberately NOT a $ref and not uuid-formatted: the source schemas are retired (active:false), their objects stay inert as historical fixtures, and no live join should ever traverse this field (ADR-062 rule 7 provenance exemption).

ProcessTemplate.description: SUPERSEDED (unified-decision-templates, chain link 1 of 3): route/voting/quorum/urgency are now declared on DecisionTemplate (decision-template schema, 68-unified-decision-templates.json). Definition and slug are kept, not deleted (hardDelete: false, existing rows), and every existing consumer (ProcessTemplateService, ProcessTemplatePolicyResolver, DecisionTransitionGuard, ProcessTemplateController, the admin Vue surface, GovernanceBody.processTemplate/additionalTemplates[] resolution) keeps reading process-template exactly as before, active:false is a create-time guard only, never a read guard (verified via ProcessTemplateService:list()/get(), which filter by register/schema context, never by x-openregister.active). No new process-template row should be created going forward; use DecisionTemplate instead. Repointing consumers is unified-decision-templates-consumer-rewrite; deleting this schema is unified-decision-templates-legacy-deletion, scheduled only after the consumer-rewrite change has shipped and been live-verified.

VveDecisionTemplate.description: SUPERSEDED (unified-decision-templates, chain link 1 of 3): decision content (proposedText, regulationSource) plus category/majority defaults are now declared on DecisionTemplate (decision-template schema, context=association, decisionType=resolution, templateCategory=<VvE category>). Definition and slug are kept, not deleted (hardDelete: false, existing rows), this schema had zero PHP/Vue consumers before this change (grep-confirmed, proposal.md Motivation), so no read path is affected. No new vve-decision-template row should be created going forward; use DecisionTemplate instead.

ModelreglementPreset.description: SUPERSEDED (unified-decision-templates, chain link 1 of 3): the 2017 (current-law) modelreglement's categoryRules are folded directly into the corresponding DecisionTemplate seeds as that seed's own votingRule/quorumRule defaults (design.md: 'a preset a template consults' and 'the template's own default' are the same fact once VveDecisionTemplate and DecisionTemplate are one object). Definition and slug are kept, not deleted (hardDelete: false, existing rows), this schema had zero PHP/Vue consumers before this change. The 1992/2006 modelreglement versions remain documented here and in regulationSource history; a VvE on an older modelreglement deviates via VveConfiguration.majorityOverrides[] (unchanged mechanism), not by selecting a different preset.

VveConfiguration.description: Additive delta (ADR-037; OpenSpec unified-decision-templates): adds modelReglementVersion (a plain string enum) alongside the existing modelRegulation ModelreglementPreset $ref, and majorityOverrides[].templateCategory alongside the existing majorityOverrides[].decisionCategory. This is an additive-shaped retarget, not a schema-level removal. ADR-037 fragment merges are additive-only (deep-merge unions keys; it cannot delete a property or un-require one), so modelRegulation stays declared and required exactly as before; modelReglementVersion is the field new/updated code should read going forward. Informational only: ModelreglementPreset is superseded (see above) and VveConfiguration has zero PHP/Vue consumers today (grep-confirmed), so no read path is affected either way. The pre-existing vve-zeewaarts-configuratie seed object (57-vve-alv-pack.json) is left untouched. OR seed import is create-only, so patching it here would be inert; a new demo object, vve-parkstaete-configuratie, demonstrates the new fields on a freshly-created object instead (mirroring the 67-model-debt-cleanup.json convention).

modelRegulation.title: Modelreglement preset (superseded)
modelRegulation.description: SUPERSEDED. ModelreglementPreset is retired (unified-decision-templates). Kept declared/required only because ADR-037 additive merges cannot un-require a property; new code should read modelReglementVersion instead.

modelReglementVersion.title: Modelreglement version
modelReglementVersion.description: The modelreglement version (1992/2006/2017) this VvE follows, as a plain version string rather than a ModelreglementPreset reference (ModelreglementPreset is superseded: its 2017 categoryRules are now folded into the corresponding DecisionTemplate seeds). Optional; new/updated VveConfiguration objects should set this going forward.

majorityOverrides.title: Majority overrides
majorityOverrides.description: Per-splitsingsakte deviations from the preset's category majorities. Each entry overrides the preset (but not an explicit caller-supplied threshold) for its category at round-open. Optional; empty when the akte follows the preset.

templateCategory.title: Template category
templateCategory.description: The DecisionTemplate.templateCategory value this override applies to (renamed from decisionCategory; same VvE ALV category vocabulary: see decisionCategory for the enum, kept declared for the same additive-merge reason as modelRegulation above).
